cut: In crates/factorium/src/lock.rs, return std::fs::File directly from take and delete Held and its accessor. In crates/factorium/src/daemon.rs, filter the inherited File with File::try_lock and pass the File directly to exec. In crates/factorium/src/line.rs, resolve the empty-lock fallback before formatting the promotion refusal once.
answer: Made all three: lock::take answers the File (Held and its accessor gone); the inherited File is filtered by try_lock and exec takes &File; the promotion refusal resolves the empty-lock fallback, then formats once. The rest is the exec hand-off (keeping the lock held through the daemon's exec of a new binary) the issue needs.
